arguments.content: P1 pattern: Input-normalization refactors can bypass an existing resilience policy when the adapter also switches from a policy-bearing repository method to its single-attempt primitive. Happy-path normalization tests and tests that assert the new exception behavior can both pass while the public recovery contract regresses. Preserve the original repository abstraction while transforming only the identifier; validate through the public entry point with transient-then-success outcomes, exhausted retry budgets, and permanent errors. Seen in preference reads (reader.py / tests/test_reads.py), isolated review 2026-10-11.
